_comment_customerLayout: Same house pattern adopted for FIR001 on 2026-09-14: customer SOA = v5 LPG ledger (plain English) + 3-row account position. Chosen deliberately for JAY000 because invoice 52688 bundles both an LPG and a CYL deposit line in one doc (v5 correctly splits it via DB debt_group) — the plain open-invoice text-heuristic model cannot split a mixed invoice and would overstate the open list; this layout reads the already-correct v5 split instead of recomputing from raw TXT refs.
